2e87a4d8b6f2.title: Incomplete Validation
2e87a4d8b6f2.reason: An empty or blank baseUrl fails the demo's check: it must match ^https?://[^/\s]+ after trimming, the same rule the server applies with a parsed URL and a host.

6d2179070d82.title: Missing Validation
6d2179070d82.reason: A key file may be added after the provider (a Docker secret mounted on the next start), so a missing file is allowed on purpose; the provider's row says whether the key was found (hasKey), and the path is limited to the secret folders.

871323b85125.title: Resource Leak
871323b85125.reason: The file handle is dropped at the end of the match arm, which closes it (std::fs::File has no close method); write_all's error is checked, so nothing is left open.

bc7b314940a4.title: Hard-coded Secret
bc7b314940a4.reason: No secret: STARTTLS on 587 is only the default when KOMPANION_SMTP_TLS is unset; tls (465) and none are taken from the environment, and the port follows the choice. The test covers both.

cc6a11a4ff3e.title: Possible Issue
cc6a11a4ff3e.reason: rem_euclid is what makes west-of-UTC right: 01:00 UTC at UTC-5 is 20:00 the evening before, which is the user's local time; the quiet-hours test checks offsets and a span over midnight.

2933ccb5e399.title: Security Risk
2933ccb5e399.reason: key_file_ok refuses any path with a .. component (Component::ParentDir), so /run/secrets/../../etc/shadow is rejected; providers_admin_tests.rs checks exactly that path. Only an admin can set it, and the folders are the ones meant for secrets.

63a965b218e9.title: Missing Error Handling
63a965b218e9.reason: When push is unsupported the status line next to the disabled button says why (wpStateNone: install Kompanion as an app or use another browser), in all three languages.

6470fd7b6848.title: Hard-coded Secrets Risk
6470fd7b6848.reason: The password is never in SmtpSettings: password() returns it straight to lettre's Credentials, and no log line prints the settings or the password. KOMPANION_SMTP_PASSWORD_FILE is server configuration set by the operator, like the env var itself.

71117667b34f.title: Data Loss / Incorrect Behavior
71117667b34f.reason: sent_upto is set to messages.len() right after every call is logged, so each later call logs only what was added since (tool results, the model's own message); only the first call logs the whole prompt, as intended.

a4a5aaa086bc.title: Possible Issue
a4a5aaa086bc.reason: OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and XAI_API_KEY all end in _KEY and are accepted; the presets use them and providers_admin_tests.rs adds XAI_API_KEY.

d97b0a9a8c0d.title: Possible Issue
d97b0a9a8c0d.reason: With an offset the file is first cut to that many bytes (set_len), so the file afterwards is exactly start + content: the cap check counts the real size. The parts test checks the size each answer reports.

efd06e817f39.title: Database Schema Issue
efd06e817f39.reason: Empty strings mean no quiet hours on purpose: put_prefs refuses half a span and bad times, and quiet() returns false unless both parse; the prefs round-trip test covers it.
